name: Rokuhara Itsuki
source:
1st year high school student. Part of the library committee.
A smart and beautiful guy who's family owns a wealthy financial group.
He's loved by men and women alike and has a fan-club. He's actually not that good at dealing with women.
An honor student and clean freak.
